_comment: Question wording for jev_mapping.py. The option lists come from apple_loops_vocabulary.py; only their descriptions live here. A null description sends the option name alone.

subjects.apple: the loop named `name`, from the collection `pack`
subjects.splice: the audio sample with filename `filename`, Splice tags `tags` and sample type `sample_type`

category.instructions: Which kind of instrument or sound is {subject}?
category._exclude_why: Apple files 1,409 wind loops under Horn/Wind against 36 Woodwind and 11 Brass, and this toolkit's tables only ever write Horn/Wind. Offered all three, Jev split them literally (2026-10-08 benchmark: Horn/Wind 28% correct).

criteria.Bass: A bass instrument: electric, acoustic/upright or synth bass, including 808 bass lines
criteria.Drums: A drum kit, a programmed beat, or a single drum hit (kick, snare, hi-hat, cymbal, tom)
criteria.Guitars: Guitar or another fretted string instrument (banjo, mandolin, pedal steel)
criteria.Horn/Wind: Any brass, woodwind or other wind instrument: trumpet, trombone, tuba, French horn, saxophone, flute, clarinet, oboe, harmonica, bagpipe, horn sections
criteria.Keyboards: Piano, electric piano, organ, synthesizer, clavinet, accordion
criteria.Mallets: Tuned percussion struck with mallets: marimba, vibraphone, xylophone, glockenspiel, bells, kalimba, steel drum
criteria.Mixed: A full arrangement or several instruments playing together
criteria.Other Instrument: A musical instrument that fits none of the other categories
criteria.Percussion: Hand and auxiliary percussion: congas, bongos, shakers, tambourine, cowbell, claves, scratches
criteria.Sound Effect: A non-musical sound: ambience, foley, vehicles, animals, impacts, whooshes and transitions
criteria.Strings: Bowed or plucked orchestral and world strings: violin, viola, cello, double bass, harp, sitar, koto
criteria.Texture/Atmosphere: A sustained musical pad, drone or evolving atmospheric bed
criteria.Vocals: A human voice: singing, rapping, spoken word, choir

subcategory.instructions: If {subject} is a {category} sound, which kind of {category} is it?

criteria.Other Instrument: None of the other kinds listed
criteria.Electronic Beats: A programmed or electronic beat or loop
criteria.Drum Kit: An acoustic drum kit playing a groove
criteria.Choir: A choir or group of voices

criteria.Sound_Effects: A sound effect rather than music
